items.difficulty_reason: Prove the implications (1) finite locally free => (2) relative effective Cartier <=> (3) locally quasi-finite + flat + lfp => (4) locally quasi-finite + flat, with (2)<=>(3) upgraded when S is Noetherian-locally and (1)<=>(2) when X -> S is proper: reduce the equivalence (2)<=>(3) to fields via divisors-lemma-fibre-Cartier; over a field the local rings of the smooth curve are one-dimensional regular (varieties-lemma-smooth-regular), hence DVRs (algebra-lemma-characterize-dvr), so every closed subscheme avoiding generic points is an effective Cartier divisor; Noetherian case: locally quasi-finite implies lfp; proper case: proper + locally quasi-finite = finite (more-morphisms-lemma-characterize-finite) and finite flat lfp = finite locally free (morphisms-lemma-finite-flat).
